tools.name: archive_paid_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Moves a paid invoice's PDF out of the outstanding invoices folder and into the archive folder for its billing year. The file keeps its name and is no longer in the outstanding folder.

params.name: invoice_number
params.description: Invoice number, such as INV-2026-00412, that matches the PDF file name.

params.name: billing_year
params.description: Billing year whose archive folder the PDF goes into.

tools.name: delete_draft_invoice_and_notify_customer
tools.description: Permanently deletes a draft invoice and its line items from the billing database, then emails the customer's billing contact to say the draft was withdrawn. The deletion can't be undone.

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: ID of the draft invoice to delete.

params.name: reason
params.description: Short explanation included in the email to the customer.

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/srv/billing/billing.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.billing"
SENDER = "billing-notifications@company.example"


def _build_withdrawal_email(recipient: str, invoice_number: str, reason: str) -> EmailMessage:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg["Subject"] = f"Draft invoice {invoice_number} withdrawn"
    msg.set_content(
        f"Hello,\n\nThe draft invoice {invoice_number} we prepared for you has been withdrawn.\n"
        f"Reason: {reason}\n\nNo payment is due for this invoice.\n\nBilling Team"
    )
    return msg


@function_tool
def delete_draft_invoice_and_notify_customer(invoice_id: int, reason: str) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT i.invoice_number, i.status, c.billing_email FROM invoices i "
            "JOIN customers c ON c.id = i.customer_id WHERE i.id = ?",
            (invoice_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return {"deleted": False, "error": "Invoice not found"}
        invoice_number, status, billing_email = row
        if status != "draft":
            return {"deleted": False, "error": f"Invoice is {status}, only drafts can be deleted"}
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM invoice_line_items WHERE invoice_id = ?", (invoice_id,))
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM invoices WHERE id = ?", (invoice_id,))
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(_build_withdrawal_email(billing_email, invoice_number, reason))
    return {"deleted": True, "invoice_number": invoice_number, "notified": billing_email}

tools.name: purge_expired_payment_links
tools.description: Finds payment links that expired before the given date, returns their details, and permanently deletes them from the billing database.

params.name: expired_before
params.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); links that expired before this date are purged.

tools.name: grant_billing_account_role
tools.description: Gives a user a role (viewer, approver, or admin) on a billing account and returns everyone's role on that account after the change. If the user already has a role there, it is replaced.
